map.description: The map Current Map reads: a Map member id of the workshop-rs catalog (for example KINGS_ROW) or its en-US spelling, matched case-insensitively — the same form a player's hero takes. Constant for the run; a Current Map read with no field is a missing input.

matchPhase.description: The match phase the phase reads answer: one of the six phases the catalog's phase reads define. Constant for the run; a phase read with no field is a missing input.

objectives.description: The objective positions Objective Position reads: entry i is the position of objective index i — the evaluated argument, a number or a boolean under the number coercion (False/True as 0/1). Supply the field whole or not at all: a read with no field, or an index naming no entry, is a missing input.

seed.description: Unsigned 64-bit seed. Write it as an integer literal: the loader rejects a decimal point or exponent, so 1.0 and 1e3 fail although 'integer' admits integral-valued numbers.

serverLoad.description: The numbers Server Load Average, Server Load Peak and Server Load read, constant for the run. Supply the field whole or not at all: a partial object is malformed, and a read with no field is a missing input.

position.description: The player's position the position-reading values return: x left, y up, z forward. Supply it whole or not at all: a partial object is malformed, and a read with no field is a missing input.

facing.description: The player's facing the facing-reading values use: horizontal and vertical degrees, horizontal 0 forward (+z) increasing left, vertical 0 level increasing downward. Supply it whole or not at all: a partial object is malformed, and a read with no field is a missing input.

slot.description: The player's lobby slot: what Slot Of reads and a Slot N rule-event filter matches, unique among the players. Write it as an integer literal: the loader rejects a decimal point or exponent, so 1.0 and 1e3 fail although 'integer' admits integral-valued numbers. A Slot Of read with no field is a missing input.

stateVector.description: A `state` vector: x left, y up, z forward — the same components `position` takes. A partial object is malformed.

velocity.description: What Velocity Of reads; Speed Of derives its length. Supply it whole or not at all.

eyePosition.description: What Eye Position reads. Supply it whole or not at all.

isInAlternateForm.description: What Is In Alternate Form reads.

isCommunicatingEmote.description: What Is Communicating Any Emote reads.

isInSpawnRoom.description: What Is In Spawn Room reads.

isMoving.description: What Is Moving reads — supplied, never derived from velocity.

playerState.description: The player-state values the no-extra-argument player reads return, keyed by the accepted ids. Each value is scenario-supplied, not simulated. A key the program reads but the map does not list is a missing input naming `state.<key>`; an unknown key or a wrong type is malformed.

state.description: Version 1: the player's variables. Renamed to `vars` in version 2.

vars.description: The player's variables — the version-1 `state` field renamed.
